def HasAlgebraicPolynomialODE (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ p : Fin (m + 1) → Polynomial AlgebraicComplex,
    (∃ i, p i ≠ 0) ∧
    ∀ z : ℂ, ∑ i, (p i).eval₂ (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).val.toRingHom z *
      iteratedDeriv i.val f z = 0

def HasStrictEArithmetic (a : ℕ → AlgebraicComplex) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
    (∀ σ : AlgebraicComplex →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ∀ n : ℕ, ‖σ (a n)‖ ≤ C ^ (n + 1)) ∧
    ∃ d : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 0 < d n) ∧ (∀ n, (d n : ℝ) ≤ C ^ (n + 1)) ∧
      ∀ n j : ℕ, j ≤ n → IsIntegral ℤ ((d n : ℂ) * (a j : ℂ))

def IsStrictEFunction (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : ℕ → AlgebraicComplex,
    Differentiable ℂ f ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, HasSum (fun n => (a n : ℂ) * z ^ n / (n.factorial : ℂ)) (f z)) ∧
    HasAlgebraicPolynomialODE f ∧ HasStrictEArithmetic a

def IsStrictEValue (u : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, IsStrictEFunction f ∧ ∃ α : AlgebraicComplex, f α = u

def IsStrictEValueUnit (u : ℂ) : Prop :=
  u ≠ 0 ∧ IsStrictEValue u ∧ IsStrictEValue u⁻¹

def Stage41IsStrictESeries (a : ℕ → AlgebraicComplex) : Prop :=
  HasStrictEArithmetic a ∧
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ p : Fin (m + 1) → Polynomial AlgebraicComplex,
      (∃ i, p i ≠ 0) ∧
      ∑ i, (p i : PowerSeries AlgebraicComplex) *
        (PowerSeries.derivative AlgebraicComplex :
          PowerSeries AlgebraicComplex → PowerSeries AlgebraicComplex)^[i.val]
          (stage41_strictFormalSeries a) = 0

def Stage17ActualEulerFrameRelation
    (B : Matrix n n (LaurentPolynomial k)) (M : Matrix n n k)
    (F : Matrix n n (subfieldEntireFunctionAlgebra k)) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : ℂˣ, ∀ i j,
    (z : ℂ) * deriv (F i j).val.val (z : ℂ) =
      (∑ l, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ k.subtype z (B i l) * (F l j).val.val (z : ℂ)) -
        ∑ l, (F i l).val.val (z : ℂ) * (M l j : ℂ)

def StrictECommonArithmeticFrameAvailability : Prop :=
  ∀ f g : ℂ → ℂ, IsStrictEFunction f → IsStrictEFunction g →
    ∃ d : ℕ,
    ∃ B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) (LaurentPolynomial (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield),
    ∃ M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield,
    ∃ F : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d)
      (subfieldEntireFunctionAlgebra (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield),
      (∀ i j, IsStrictEFunction (F i j).val.val) ∧
      (∀ a : (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield,
        (minpoly (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield M).IsRoot a →
          ∃ q : ℚ, (q : (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield) = a) ∧
      Stage17ActualEulerFrameRelation (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield B M F ∧
      (F.map (stage14_subfieldEntireEvaluation (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield 1)).det ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ v w : Fin d → ℂ → ℂ,
        (∀ i, IsStrictEFunction (v i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsStrictEFunction (w i)) ∧
        (∀ z : ℂˣ, ∀ i, (z : ℂ) * deriv (v i) (z : ℂ) =
          ∑ l, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield.subtype z
            (B i l) * v l (z : ℂ)) ∧
        (∀ z : ℂˣ, ∀ i, (z : ℂ) * deriv (w i) (z : ℂ) =
          ∑ l, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield.subtype z
            (B i l) * w l (z : ℂ)) ∧
        ∃ i j : Fin d, v i = f ∧ w j = g

def StrictELaurentRelationLifting : Prop :=
  ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : ι → entireFunctionAlgebra)
    (A : Matrix ι ι (LaurentPolynomial AlgebraicComplex)),
    (∀ i, IsStrictEFunction (f i).val) →
    (∀ z : ℂˣ, ∀ i, deriv (f i).val (z : ℂ) =
      ∑ j, arithmeticLaurentEvaluation z (A i j) * (f j).val (z : ℂ)) →
    ∀ P : MvPolynomial ι AlgebraicComplex,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).val.toRingHom
        (fun i => (f i).val 1) P = 0 →
      ∃ Q : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι AlgebraicComplex),
        (∀ z : ℂ, Polynomial.eval₂
          (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).val.toRingHom
            (fun i => (f i).val z)) z Q = 0) ∧ Q.eval 1 = P

def StrictERegularMinimalNonvanishingAtOne : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : IsStrictEFunction f), f ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ (b : Fin m → RatFunc AlgebraicComplex),
      OrdinaryBorelMinimalCyclicData
        (stage14_subfieldEntireLaurentAlgHom (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).toSubfield
          (strictEFunctionTaylorRealization f hf)) m b →
      (∀ i, ∃ S : PowerSeries AlgebraicComplex,
        HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries ℤ AlgebraicComplex S = ordinaryPointRationalMap 1 (b i)) →
      f 1 ≠ 0

structure Stage33ScalarNormalForm (k : Subfield ℂ) (m : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → Polynomial k) where
  N : ℕ
  ramification_ne_zero : N ≠ 0
  e : Fin m → subfieldEntireFunctionAlgebra k
  M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k
  Z : (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (LaurentLogBase k))ˣ

  rational : ∀ a : k, (minpoly k M).IsRoot a → ∃ q : ℚ, (q : k) = a

    ramifiedConstantMatrix M * Z.val

    Polynomial.aeval

      ((stage32_ramifiedOrdinaryDerivation k N ramification_ne_zero) :
        RatFunc (LaurentSeries k) → RatFunc (LaurentSeries k))^[l.val]
          (stage33_scalarNormalFormRow k N ramification_ne_zero e Z j) = 0
  independent : LinearIndependent k
    (stage33_scalarNormalFormRow k N ramification_ne_zero e Z)
